findings.evidence: Dashboard section (lines 225-268) describes CDN libraries, filter-bar order, two-line clamp, chart debounce 150ms and tooltip behaviour
findings.fix: Keep only the facts that change how the agent reports results (em dash means unknown, conditional badge, auto-open). Move the UI layout description to references/dashboard.md, or delete it because the generated HTML already shows it.

findings.evidence: The PRD's own intended trigger is "after the first real end-to-end runs ... not before real data exists to mine" ... not something this phase's own automated delivery performs
findings.fix: Replace the PRD and phase history with one line: run classify only when the user asks, after real data exists. Move the provenance to a trailing section.

findings.evidence: Subcommands list run/capture/refine/dashboard/classify but gives no procedure for answering a user's usage question (which subcommand to run, or how to query refined.db with the dedup rule)
findings.fix: Add a short decision procedure: a fresh view goes to `run`; a question about existing data goes to a read-only sqlite3 query on refined.db with the two-branch dedup (give one example SQL); a request to mine opaque rows goes to `classify` then `dashboard`.

findings.evidence: NEVER list is strong, but there is no gotcha for an empty or missing source (for example no opencode.db or no Cursor dir) or for the browser auto-open in headless shells
findings.fix: Add gotchas: a missing source store is skipped, not an error (say what the output shows), and `run`/`dashboard` call webbrowser.open unconditionally, so in a headless or SSH session report the file:// path instead of claiming the dashboard opened.

findings.evidence: Does not export or import data; never a hosted-database Artifact.
findings.fix: Build and open a local static HTML usage dashboard from Claude Code, opencode, Codex, Cursor and rtk session logs (capture, refine into refined.db, render dashboard.html). Use when the user asks about AI CLI usage metrics, which shell commands or tools their agents ran, grep/git command frequency per session or day, token or price totals per runtime or model, or wants to query refined.db, even without saying 'metrics'. Not for live status-line quota or cost displays, not for exporting or uploading session data, and not for scheduling recurring runs.

findings.evidence: 311-line body holds the full 29-column schema, dashboard UI detail and Codex tool-name enumeration inline, with no references/
findings.fix: Move the column-by-column schema and the dashboard/subfamily detail to references/schema.md and references/dashboard.md. Gate each with a trigger such as 'Read references/schema.md before writing SQL against refined.db'. Keep the dedup rule and the NEVER list in SKILL.md.
Use the same exact form as the run example: `python3 "$TOOLS_PY" classify` then `python3 "$TOOLS_PY" dashboard`. A bare script name is not on PATH.

findings.evidence: The skill directory has no evals/: no evals/evals.json and no evals/trigger-queries.json
findings.fix: Add evals/evals.json with 3 or more realistic prompts (for example 'how many rg calls did I run last week per session', a Cursor date question, an edge case with no sources present). Use scratch-env input files under evals/files/ and verifiable assertions such as 'totals deduped on (session_id, turn_id)' and 'Cursor rows flagged low confidence'. Add evals/trigger-queries.json with about 20 queries, including near-misses such as status-line cost and exporting chat history.

findings.evidence: print("usage: ai-kit-usage-metrics.py {capture|refine|dashboard|classify|run}") — --help gives no description, examples or exit codes, and subcommands emit no structured summary; tests/test_ai_kit_usage_metrics.py (163 tests) is otherwise thorough
findings.fix: Expand --help with one line per subcommand, env overrides and exit codes (0 ok, 2 unknown subcommand). Print a one-line JSON summary per subcommand (records captured, rows refined, dashboard path) to stdout.

findings.evidence: python3 "$TOOLS_PY" run — no guidance on a non-zero exit, a missing refined.db, or what to report to the user afterwards
findings.fix: After the run block add: on a non-zero exit, show stderr and stop. If refined.db is missing, run `refine` before `dashboard`. When done, report the dashboard file:// path and row counts per runtime, with the codex lower-bound and Cursor low-confidence caveats.
Put the substitution instruction from line 61 before the code block, or give a concrete example, so the agent does not run the literal placeholder.
